title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace — Episode10 Ephemeral Melody

meta.Event Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You seem to be in a good mood lately, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, you've just seemed very lively. Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well, my friends have been having quite a lot of fun lately...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And it makes me happy to see it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
You must care about them quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I'm so glad that you grew up to be such a kind girl.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everyone seems to be having fun...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, you composed a song for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because you've done so much for me, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You taught me how to write better, learned how to draw with me... And we visited the brass band together, too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So I thought, you know, I'd like to give something back.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. I did it because I wanted to. Because I've really had a lot of fun with you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll accept my gift.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can I listen to it now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's nice song that's very gentle.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's just...
I get the feeling that it isn't to your liking.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'm sorry. I'll make another one. I want to write a song that you genuinely like, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing.
I really do like this song a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have to compose anything for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Dad, didn't you say that you'd be gone for that meeting today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. I actually just got home a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I composed a song for my friend, but I don't think she liked it very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I thought I'd compose another one for her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But she said that I didn't have to.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's only natural my song didn't really resonate with her. I mean, I can't compose the way you do, Dad. I don't know how to make people happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We became friends only just recently, so I can't say that I know her all that well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... Seeing that pain in her eyes... I can't just leave her like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? That's odd...
I feel like I've said that before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: If that's what you wish, Kanade, then it sounds like you've already made up your mind what to do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm going to compose another song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It needs to go deeper and feel colder... But still let a small ray of light shine through...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know why it looked like she was in pain.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It could just be a big misunderstanding.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even if it's for only a second, I want her to smile.)
I'm not sure this song will be able to clear up what's on that girl's mind...
What is it that you want people to see or realize by hearing this?
Your songs really are nice and gentle...
<K, this song will reach her for sure.>
You promise to keep writing music as long as it takes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's why I kept composing all those songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope this one reaches the others...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it needs to be darker and feel heavier... Like the walls are closing in...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Forget it. This is all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How many times is that? I've lost count.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to keep drawing and drawing and drawing and drawing!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't even know what's good or bad at this point.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I feel like I have to keep drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Hey, have you heard K's new song?>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I did!
It's a little different from her usual stuff.
Kinda dark, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think her old style was better.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: K...? The girl who composes those really cheerful songs?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It wasn't really my cup of tea, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here's the URL...
I guess I can listen to it for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My chest feels so tight and terrible... But also warm...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I can't find the right words for it...
But I need to express this feeling!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try layering on some darker colors here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, that's only the sunken feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It needs more light, more contrast with the shadows...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That K person gave me the push I needed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. I could upload this as a piece of fan art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know if anyone is gonna see it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, why does it feel like I'm forgetting something really important? Like there's a gaping hole in my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? A DM? W-Why? From who...?

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Enanan.
I'll be waiting for you on Nightcord.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter where I go, you always know how to find me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mhm, mhm!
It turned out super cute! And this is my first one! How awesome am I?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want someone to see it, but An's probably asleep... Maybe I'll post it on social media.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, making a piece of clothing from scratch by yourself really takes forever...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I'm just doing it as a hobby, so that doesn't really matter.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, what should I design next?
Another dress might be fun, but I could also change things up and make a piece of outerwear...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This song... It's by that K person.
I could take a quick break and listen to it.
<I was able to compose that song because you helped me open my eyes.>
It was nice to see you again...
N25's been waiting for you to come back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Making stuff with the others...
I really love doing that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (How long is this going to last...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You wish to be there for people. You really do have a big heart, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Regardless of the path you choose in life, I'm sure you'll find a way to succeed, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She hasn't been at school since yesterday. I should have guessed she was composing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess going to school every day has helped increase my stamina a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Despite running over here, I feel less tired than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's why I always say you should exercise more.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. My body knows that now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu. Did you listen to my song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you wait so long.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's not your fault, Kanade.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You could at least let yourself dream of doing anything else.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. I did, and it was fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But in the end... What I want is to compose for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm also glad that I got to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's go on Nightcord.
I've already contacted Ena and Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This is all a dream? But it feels so real.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know, right? I thought you were supposed to bolt awake once you realize it's all a dream, for stuff like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm not sure that's how things work here.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My memories came back a while ago.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why didn't you say anything, Mafuyu?! That means you were...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Because you all seemed to be enjoying yourselves.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I thought I should leave things be...for at least a little while longer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Not seeing any of you when the clock struck 25:00...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry we left you so alone, Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Honestly! That's even more reason to speak up!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Now, now. Still, this does mean we have a LOT of catching up to do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, you wanna work until the sun comes up?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. I wanna draw something for N25. It feels like it's been so long.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sorry, Dad.
I might be staying up fairly late tonight.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
I know you love composing, but please remember to rest when you can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Remember how you said you'd do something for me if I did well on my tests...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Can I ask you for that favor now?
I promise to study really hard...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because... I feel like it's been really long since I last heard you sing one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: A song of support for my hard worker, then. Let me go get my guitar.
